description:
Extend the RF1 ingest capability from perf-tpch-rf1-bulk-load-20261031 to SingleStore (benchbox/platforms/singlestore.py, supports_refresh_functions = True). SingleStore refresh was proven on local containers (see tpch-refresh-functions-in-power-and-throughput), and the adapter sets local_infile=True, so no live-cloud spend is involved.

Spec: TPC-H 3.0.1 clause 5.3.7.10: parsing, formatting and database activity on the refresh data stay inside the RF1 timer; nothing precedes the timer except relocation. For SingleStore nothing precedes the timer.

Check (agent-actionable, record the result): the server accepts LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE on the target container (server-side local_infile enabled). If it does not and cannot be enabled by the existing container configuration, record that and leave SingleStore on the VALUES fallback; close this item as not applicable with that evidence.

Guardrails for all code work: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in source (make comment-policy-check). Durations use benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()/elapsed_seconds(). Add a changelog.d/ fragment. Cited line numbers are orientation only: re-read the named symbols, docs and spec clauses before editing and treat a mismatch as a reason to stop and update this item. No live-cloud runs without owner approval; heavy runs only through make heavy-run or a lock-taking entry point. Green focused tests are not release certification. Do not call adapter.load_data. Do not add a mode that moves any step before the timer. Stays on the fallback unless the parity and speed criteria pass.
